description: This file contains a suite of testing utilities for comparing tensor-like and numeric data structures in PyTorch, including functions for asserting closeness of tensors, error message generation, and comparison pair classes.

classes.name: ErrorMeta
classes.description: Internal exception class that carries error metadata and can be converted to specific exceptions.

classes.name: Pair
classes.description: Abstract base class for comparison pairs, defining the interface for comparing two inputs.

classes.name: ObjectPair
classes.description: Fallback comparison pair that uses '==' operator for any types.

classes.name: NonePair
classes.description: Comparison pair specifically for None types.

classes.name: BooleanPair
classes.description: Comparison pair for boolean types, including numpy bools if numpy is available.

classes.name: NumberPair
classes.description: Comparison pair for Python numeric types, with tolerances and optional dtype checks.

classes.name: TensorLikePair
classes.description: Comparison pair for torch.Tensor-like objects, supporting detailed attribute and value comparisons.

methods.name: tuple[float,float] default_tolerances( *inputs: Union[torch.Tensor, torch.dtype], dtype_precisions: Optional[dict[torch.dtype, tuple[float, float]]] = None, )
methods.description: Returns default relative and absolute tolerances based on input tensor or dtype.

methods.name: tuple[float,float] get_tolerances( *inputs: Union[torch.Tensor, torch.dtype], rtol: Optional[float], atol: Optional[float], id: tuple[Any, ...] = (), )
methods.description: Determines tolerances for numeric comparison based on inputs or explicit rtol/atol.

methods.name: _make_bitwise_mismatch_msg( *, default_identifier: str, identifier: Optional[Union[str, Callable[[str], str]]] = None, extra: Optional[str] = None, first_mismatch_idx: Optional[tuple[int, ...]] = None, )
methods.description: Generates error message for bitwise mismatches in float8-like tensors.

methods.name: str _make_mismatch_msg( *, default_identifier: str, identifier: Optional[Union[str, Callable[[str], str]]] = None, extra: Optional[str] = None, abs_diff: float, abs_diff_idx: Optional[Union[int, tuple[int, ...]]] = None, atol: float, rel_diff: float, rel_diff_idx: Optional[Union[int, tuple[int, ...]]] = None, rtol: float, )
methods.description: Generates detailed mismatch error messages for numeric comparisons.

methods.name: str make_scalar_mismatch_msg( actual: Union[bool, int, float, complex], expected: Union[bool, int, float, complex], *, rtol: float, atol: float, identifier: Optional[Union[str, Callable[[str], str]]] = None, )
methods.description: Creates error message for scalar value mismatches.

methods.name: make_tensor_mismatch_msg( actual: torch.Tensor, expected: torch.Tensor, matches: torch.Tensor, *, rtol: float, atol: float, identifier: Optional[Union[str, Callable[[str], str]]] = None, )
methods.description: Creates error message for tensor value mismatches, including index and difference details.

methods.name: assert_close( actual: Any, expected: Any, *, allow_subclasses: bool = True, rtol: Optional[float] = None, atol: Optional[float] = None, equal_nan: bool = False, check_device: bool = True, check_dtype: bool = True, check_layout: bool = True, check_stride: bool = False, msg: Optional[Union[str, Callable[[str], str]]] = None, )
methods.description: Main function to assert that two nested data structures or tensors are numerically close within tolerances.

methods.name: None assert_allclose( actual: Any, expected: Any, rtol: Optional[float] = None, atol: Optional[float] = None, equal_nan: bool = True, msg: str = "", )
methods.description: Deprecated alias for `assert_close`, issues a warning and calls `assert_close`.

methods.name: list[Pair] originate_pairs( actual: Any, expected: Any, *, pair_types: Sequence[type[Pair]], sequence_types: tuple[type, ...] = (collections.abc.Sequence,), mapping_types: tuple[type, ...] = (collections.abc.Mapping,), id: tuple[Any, ...] = (), **options: Any, )
methods.description: Recursively creates comparison pairs from nested sequences and mappings.

methods.name: list[ErrorMeta] not_close_error_metas( actual: Any, expected: Any, *, pair_types: Sequence[type[Pair]] = (ObjectPair,), sequence_types: tuple[type, ...] = (collections.abc.Sequence,), mapping_types: tuple[type, ...] = (collections.abc.Mapping,), **options: Any, )
methods.description: Checks that inputs are not close, returning a list of error metadata if they are not.
